zh: 武汉大学（Wuhan University，简称武大）溯源于1893年创办的自强学堂，位于中国湖北省武汉市武昌区珞珈山，是中华人民共和国教育部直属的全国重点大学，位列国家"双一流""985工程""211工程"建设高校。在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第186位，相比去年的194位上升8名，成功跻身世界前200强。学校拥有5195亩占地面积，珞珈山主校区被誉为中国最美大学之一。
en: Wuhan University (WHU), tracing its roots to Ziqiang Academy founded in 1893, is located on Luojia Hill, Wuchang District, Wuhan, Hubei Province, China. It is a national key university directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, ranking among the "Double First-Class", "985 Project", and "211 Project" universities. Ranked 186th in the QS World University Rankings 2026, it rose 8 places from 194th last year, successfully entering the world's top 200. Covering 5,195 mu, its Luojia Hill main campus is known as one of China's most beautiful universities.
